parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of durable plastic. It is flat and rectangular, designed to support the user's weight.
parts.Functional_description: The seat provides the main sitting surface for the user, distributing body weight evenly and ensuring comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It is attached to the folding frame and can pivot upward when the chair is folded for storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the folding chair, made of tubular steel. It includes the legs and backrest frame.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and stability to the chair, allowing it to bear the user's weight and maintain balance.
parts.Movement_description: It includes pivot joints that allow the chair to fold and unfold smoothly for portability and storage.
